Meet an ORDS instructor

Bryan

Silver Spring ORDS Team / Drum Instructor

Common questions

Before you schedule.

Still unsure? Call ORDS at (703) 475-8719.

Are beginners welcome?

Yes. Bryan can help students start with fundamentals such as grip, posture, counting, coordination, and basic grooves.

Where are these lessons offered?

This campaign is for private drum lesson availability through the Silver Spring ORDS team. Exact lesson and scheduling details are confirmed during consultation.

Is Bryan part of ORDS?

Yes. Bryan is an ORDS drum instructor serving the Silver Spring program and works as part of the wider ORDS Music School team.

How much are lessons?

Schedule a free consultation and the ORDS team will confirm current pricing, availability, and lesson details before you make any commitment.
